speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked	the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) for each year from 2011 to 2016, what has been the price difference between Singapore's regulated electricity tariff and that of OECD countries which use gas as the main fuel for power generation.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: There are only a handful of Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) countries that rely on natural gas as their main fuel source for power generation.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
text: These are Mexico, the Netherlands, Ireland, Turkey and Japan, which use gas for 40% to 57% of their electricity needs.
